title: QA Panel
subtitle: Create a test owner, test manager, and test tenant, isolated from your real company, to freely test the system.
isolationNote: These records live in a separate test company — they don't show up in Owners/Tenants or anywhere else in the system.

form.name: Name
form.password: Password (optional — creates a ready login for the portal)
form.tenantPasswordHint: If filled, the tenant already gets a ready login (skips self-signup). Also needs an email.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.tenantEmailForLogin: Enter the tenant's email to create the login

edit.title: Edit test record
edit.emailLocked: Login email can't be changed here.
edit.newPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
edit.setPassword: Password (creates a login for the tenant)
edit.setPasswordHint: If filled, creates a new login for this tenant (also needs an email).

generate.hint: Fills the form with test data and copies it to the clipboard, ready to paste and send to QA
generate.copied: Test data copied! Just paste and send it to QA.
generate.copyError: Couldn't copy — copy the fields manually
